result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back in all six listings plus the lookup by code. The full suite passes offline: 608 tests, 0 failures, including a new test for the description.

What changed:

- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(255)` column on `promotion`.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: `description` is the last record component. It is null when none was given.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new `createPromotion(code, discount, start, end, category, description)` overload. The existing 5-argument method delegates to it with `null`, so current callers are unchanged. A blank description is stored as null, the same way a blank category is handled.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the promotion insert writes the description. The six promotion queries (by code, active on date, active in region, by category, best for category, unused in period) select it and map it. I left the non-promotion queries alone.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new `returnsDescriptionWithPromotionInEveryListing` test. It creates one promotion with a description and one without, then checks the text in each listing.

I didn't change `DemoScenario`, so the demo output is unchanged. Nothing is committed.
